# zkvote-client

A typed TypeScript client for the Soroban contract `CDZZXVGUCLBUTE3WDD6TF2NXPTBPOYTVPPBBIZMSPVIQLUG226XJ4PAN` on `testnet`.

Generated by [SoroVault](https://github.com/soroworks/sorovault) from the
interface with WASM hash `abc123`. Regenerate it when the contract's interface
changes rather than editing it by hand.

## Install

```console
npm install zkvote-client
```

`@stellar/stellar-sdk` and `buffer` are peer dependencies, so the package
uses the SDK version your project already depends on.

## Use

```ts
import { connect } from "zkvote-client";
import { Networks } from "@stellar/stellar-sdk";

const client = await connect({
  rpcUrl: "https://soroban-testnet.stellar.org",
  networkPassphrase: Networks.TESTNET,
});
```

`connect` defaults to the contract ID the package was generated for;
pass `contractId` to point the same client at another deployment.

## Build

```console
npm install
npm run build
```

The build writes `dist/index.js` and `dist/index.d.ts`.

## Version

This package was generated as version `0.0.0-abc123`, derived from the interface's
WASM hash. To publish it under a version of your own, edit `version` in
`package.json` or regenerate with `--package-version`.
